title: 查询网页里所有域名注册时间书签（Bookmarklet）
author: 哥飞
content:
用法如下，随便找一个书签，邮件点击修改，然后修改名称为你自己想要的，如我写的是“看 whois”，再把下面的代码填到网址栏，保存。
然后打开任意一个有网址有域名的网页，点击这个书签，就自动会抓取whois信息里的域名注册时间，显示到域名前面。
如果点击没反应，可能是 Windows 和 MacOS的系统兼容性问题，你把代码发给 GPT，让他帮你修正下。
代码如下：
javascript:(function(){var supportedSuffixes=['com','box','net','org','me','xyz','im','info','io','co','ai','biz','us','app','sg','cafe','now','shop','life','cn','uk','chat','design','fun','website','link','site','online','cards','fr','sk','it','new','video'];var domainCache={};var STORAGE_KEY='domain_whois_cache';function loadFromStorage(){try{var stored=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);if(stored){domainCache=JSON.parse(stored)}}catch(e){console.warn('Failed to load from localStorage:',e)}}function saveToStorage(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(domainCache))}catch(e){console.warn('Failed to save to localStorage:',e)}}loadFromStorage();var style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='.domain-date{color:#2e7d32;font-weight:bold;background:#e8f5e8;padding:1px 3px;border-radius:2px;font-size:0.9em}';document.head.appendChild(style);function isSuffixSupported(domain){var parts=domain.split('.');var suffix=parts[parts.length-1];return supportedSuffixes.includes(suffix)}function parseDomain(domain){var parts=domain.split('.');if(parts.length<2)return null;var suffix=parts[parts.length-1];var name=parts[parts.length-2];return{name:name,suffix:suffix}}function queryWhois(domain){return new Promise(function(resolve){if(domainCache[domain]!==undefined){resolve(domainCache[domain]);return}var parsed=parseDomain(domain);if(!parsed){domainCache[domain]=null;saveToStorage();resolve(null);return}var name=parsed.name;var suffix=parsed.suffix;var url='https://whois.freeaiapi.xyz/?name='+name+'&suffix='+suffix+'&c=1';fetch(url).then(function(response){return response.json()}).then(function(data){var result=null;if(data&&data.status==='ok'&&data.creation_datetime){var dateStr=data.creation_datetime.trim();var date=new Date(dateStr);result='('+date.getFullYear()+'.'+(date.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0')+')'}domainCache[domain]=result;saveToStorage();resolve(result)}).catch(function(e){console.error('Query failed:',domain,e);domainCache[domain]=null;saveToStorage();resolve(null)})})}function extractDomainsFromText(){var domains=new Set();var domainRegex=/\b(?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+(?:com|box|net|org|me|xyz|im|info|io|co|ai|biz|us|app|sg|cafe|now|shop|life|cn|uk|chat|design|fun|website|link|site|online|cards|fr|sk|it|new|video)\b/g;function processNode(node){if(node.nodeType===3){var text=node.textContent;var matches=text.match(domainRegex);if(matches){matches.forEach(function(domain){domains.add(domain.toLowerCase())})}}else if(node.nodeType===1&&node.tagName!=='SCRIPT'&&node.tagName!=='STYLE'){for(var i=0;i<node.childNodes.length;i++){processNode(node.childNodes[i])}}}processNode(document.body);return Array.from(domains)}function replaceDomainInText(textNode,domain,datePrefix){var text=textNode.textContent;var regex=new RegExp('\\b'+domain.replace(/\./g,'\\.')+'\\b','gi');if(regex.test(text)){var parent=textNode.parentNode;var newHTML=text.replace(regex,function(match){return '<span class="domain-date">'+datePrefix+'</span>'+match});var wrapper=document.createElement('span');wrapper.innerHTML=newHTML;while(wrapper.firstChild){parent.insertBefore(wrapper.firstChild,textNode)}parent.removeChild(textNode)}}function updateDomainDisplay(domain,datePrefix){var walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,function(node){return node.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(domain)?NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT:NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT});var textNodes=[];var node;while(node=walker.nextNode()){textNodes.push(node)}textNodes.forEach(function(textNode){if(textNode.parentNode&&textNode.parentNode.tagName!=='SCRIPT'&&textNode.parentNode.tagName!=='STYLE'){replaceDomainInText(textNode,domain,datePrefix)}})}function processDomain(domain){return new Promise(function(resolve){if(!isSuffixSupported(domain)){resolve();return}queryWhois(domain).then(function(datePrefix){if(datePrefix){updateDomainDisplay(domain,datePrefix)}resolve()})})}function main(){var domains=extractDomainsFromText();if(domains.length===0){alert('No domains found in page text');return}console.log('Found domains:',domains);var uniqueDomains=Array.from(new Set(domains));var progressDiv=document.createElement('div');progressDiv.id='domain-progress';progressDiv.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:10px;right:10px;background:#333;color:white;padding:10px;border-radius:5px;z-index:10000;font-size:14px';progressDiv.textContent='Processing '+uniqueDomains.length+' unique domains...';document.body.appendChild(progressDiv);var batchSize=3;var currentIndex=0;function processBatch(){if(currentIndex>=uniqueDomains.length){setTimeout(function(){var elem=document.getElementById('domain-progress');if(elem)elem.remove()},2000);return}var batch=uniqueDomains.slice(currentIndex,currentIndex+batchSize);Promise.all(batch.map(processDomain)).then(function(){currentIndex+=batchSize;progressDiv.textContent='Processed '+Math.min(currentIndex,uniqueDomains.length)+'/'+uniqueDomains.length+' domains';setTimeout(processBatch,800)})}processBatch()}main()})();
我电脑是 MacOS ，如果你是 Windows 电脑，可能会遇到兼容性问题，把代码发给 AI，让 AI 帮你改就好了。
